name: Iran
blurb: Seven borders from the Caucasus to the Gulf. Restore the empire of Cyrus.

name: Ethiopia
blurb: Seven frontiers around the mountain empire, every one of them a colony. Restore Aksum from the Nile to the Red Sea.

name: France
blurb: Seven frontiers from the Rhine to the Pyrenees. Restore the empire of Napoleon.

name: Greece
blurb: Three mountain borders and four seas. Restore the empire of Basil II, from the Danube to Antioch.

name: Mexico
blurb: Seven fronts from Alta California to Costa Rica. Restore the empire of the Three Guarantees.

name: Peru
blurb: Seven frontiers from the Putumayo to Tacna. Restore the Inca realm of the four quarters.

name: Siam
blurb: Seven fronts from the Shan hills to the Malay sultanates. Restore the tributary realm of the early Chakri kings.

name: Turkey
blurb: Seven fronts from the Danube to the Tigris. Restore the empire of Süleyman.
